A1_built_artifacts_carry_the_new_surface.evidence: byte-level reads in bytes.txt. TUI dist (161524 B): `var TEAM_MODEL_SLOTS = ["slot1", "slot2", "slot3"]` + `teamModelSlotSchema`(4 hits)+`TEAM_MODEL_SLOT_DEFAULTS`(4)+`TEAM_MODEL_FALLBACK_OPTIONS`(3) + the three leaf names (provider/model/reasoningEffort, 3 hits each) + the catalog-derived wiring (`teamModelOptionLists` 3, `llmCatalog` 9, the branch marker `slot options: provider=` 1, `catalog=` 1). The nine dot-paths are COMPOSED at runtime from that literal, which is why a literal-path grep returns 0 — and the runtime half of the proof is tui-arm.json: the section the BUILT dist registers carries exactly paths teamModels.slot1.provider … teamModels.slot3.reasoningEffort (9/9). client.js (310367 B): exactly NINE `{ path: ["teamModels", "slotN", "leaf"] … }` entries (counted 9, one each), each `kind: "select"` with declared options, plus the dependent-picker wiring (optionsFor 4, optgroup 3, optionElements 3, modelDirectories 8, reasoningEffort 21). The path composition in the built bytes (bytes.txt ADDENDUM): `teamModels: import_schemastery.default.object({…})`, `path: ["teamModels", slot, leaf]` and `hint: knobHint(`teamModels.${slot}.${leaf}`, TEAM_MODEL_SLOT_SEMANTICS[slot])` — i.e. the nine dotted keys and their hints are BUILT from the slot list × the leaf list inside the artifact, and the artifact's own runtime output (tui-arm.json) shows the resulting nine paths.

A2_real_mount_no_abort_and_namespace_has.evidence: driver/t9-web-mount.mjs booted `dsh --profile w --patch <probe overlay> --no-open` in DSH_HOME=/tmp/…/home + HOME=/tmp/…/userhome + sandbox workspace, with the QA probe row inserted by the overlay. mount-checks.json M1: zero apply-crash signatures and zero loader aborts ('failed to apply loader entry' absent). M2: the mpd-config and mpd-tui rows are composed (recorded as COMPOSITION ONLY). M3: the adapter seam answered inside the boot. M4/M4b: the SERVED `mpd` namespace descriptor (revision 0, applies=restart) reports exactly the NINE new slot knobs. Boot log additionally carries `[mpd-dsh-adapter] mpdDsh provided` and `[mpd-config] settings bridge: registered the "mpd" namespace with the file-derived base`. Note on the mpd-tui row: the web profile has no tuiSettingsSections service and no stdout sink for its diagnostics, so no [mpd-tui] stdout line appears; the row's APPLY is evidenced by the absence of the harness's 'failed to apply loader entry' marker (the tree came up far enough for the last patch layer's probe to read the adapter and the config namespace).

A3_settings_round_trip_on_the_intended_r.evidence: mount-checks.json M5/M6/M7 (defaults): keyed service reads get("teamModels.slot1|2|3") = deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash at max/high/high; mpd_config_get({key:"teamModels"}).payload.value and mpd_config_get({}).payload.config.teamModels carry the same three defaults. M8 NEGATIVE CONTROL: the parameterless get() is the RAW merged view (keys [] in a fresh sandbox) and does NOT materialise teamModels — the documented asymmetry, recorded as the negative control rather than as a defect. M9: settingsMutate("mpd", set teamModels.slot1.{provider,model,reasoningEffort}) = {ok:true}. M10: after the write the TOOL surface resolves slot1 = {provider:t9-probe-provider, model:t9-probe-model, reasoningEffort:low}. M11: the keyed service read AND the namespace descriptor agree on the same values. M12: the untouched slots kept their defaults. M13: after an `unset` the schema default is back on the tool surface (max).

A4_tui_half_measured_both_branch_and_non.evidence: tui-arm.json — the BUILT dist applied through its real apply() against a stub host, with the REAL adapter build as mpdDsh, in THREE arms so the branch is measured, not assumed. LIVE: 'settings section mpd slot options: provider=live(2) model=live(2) reasoningEffort=live(2) catalog=live' and the registered section's 9 slot fields each carry 2 options. DEGRADED (catalog answered {providers:[],degraded:true}): 'declared(1)/declared(4)/declared(4) catalog=degraded', 9 fields non-empty. UNAVAILABLE (mounted adapter without the llmCatalog seam): 'declared(1)/declared(4)/declared(4) catalog=unavailable', 9 fields non-empty. In all three arms the section carried 22 fields and the nine slot fields were exactly the teamModels.* paths, kind=select, non-empty. LIMITATION stated in the artifact: this is a stub-host registration against the built bytes, NOT a dsh-tui process boot (a TUI profile needs a network install of @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui@0.10.1 + tmux), so no in-process TUI boot is claimed; the real bundled-boot half is A2.
